headline: Cyber End Dragon
title: Cyber End Dragon Explained | What It Does and How to Use It | Yu-Gi-Oh
video_script: This is Cyber End Dragon. What is it? It is a Level ten LIGHT Machine Fusion Monster with four thousand attack. What does it do? It is three Cyber Dragons fused, and when it attacks a Defense Position monster it deals piercing battle damage. How do you use it? It can only be Fusion Summoned with three Cyber Dragon. It is in Duelist Pack: Zane Truesdale. Which card should I explain next? Comment below!
